I cannot answer this question from the supplied passages.

The contract requests the top 10 RAN4 specs ranked by CR count. However, the source passages do not contain per-spec CR counts. The common_source_data inventory only maps specifications to responsible primary codes (e.g., which specs are "R4"/RAN4 responsibility); it explicitly states it "does not establish any graph edge, CR count, applied change." The TDoc chunks show individual CRs (mostly against TS 38.133) but do not provide any complete, countable population of CRs per spec that would support a ranking.

The instructions require: do not treat a finite retrieved sample as an entire population, and do not guess counts. No passage provides the counts needed to rank the top 10.
